mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, nickname, phone, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, phone, avatar, status, created_at, updated_at FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, phone, avatar, status, created_at, updated_at FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, avatar = #{avatar} WHERE id = #{id}
